## Workshop Location and Dates

The DataSHIELD Without Borders workshop will be delivered over four days at the following institution:

::: {.table-responsive}
| Dates | Institution | Location |
|-------|-------------|----------|
| **June 15–18, 2026** | Armauer Hansen Research Institute (AHRI) | Addis Ababa, Ethiopia |
: {.table .table-striped .table-hover}
:::
